title: Quality rules kept only in memory move into relay
what: Go through the memory notes that exist only in memory (no-guard-workarounds, record-measurements-at-once, paths-via-env-var, strategy-and-wave-digest, bun-not-node, core-is-the-standard-package, paid-checks-preapproved, taste-means-judgement). Each that is a strict rule for a wide range of cases goes into relay's rules/ (or relay's own project rules when it is about relay only) so relay sync delivers it; a personal preference or a one-machine fact stays in memory. The memory notes themselves are not touched by this item.
why: Owner, 27 Oct: "наша задача сделать так чтобы строгие правила, применимые для широкого диапазона случаев жили в relay и доставлялись до всех проектов, чтобы качество не падало, это будет пусть и не персональный вариант для чистой сборки но вариант отвечающий критериям качества relay" (memory management itself deferred: "На текущий момент отложим вопрос управления памятью о проекте"). Front's grep that day: of 23 behaviour notes in this Mac's Claude memory for relay, 15 already match text in relay's rules, 8 exist only in memory; some of those 8 are quality rules a clean run would lose. IP chosen by the front (agent-chosen).
